title: Estimating the Probability of Rare Catastrophic Outputs: A Toy Low-Probability-Estimation Benchmark

original_idea.body:
# A Toy Low-Probability-Estimation Benchmark

Compare Monte Carlo, importance sampling, activation extrapolation on a known rare-event task; chart accuracy vs compute.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: LPE is a load-bearing piece of ARC's catastrophic-output-catching agenda; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Known-ground-truth toy task with standard estimators; clear methodology for novice+mentor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused accuracy-vs-compute comparison; several estimators to implement.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected long-horizon ARC problem; external reproducible micro-benchmark.

novelty.reasoning: LPE has some work; an accessible empirical estimator comparison may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: LPE framing exists; accessible estimator-comparison benchmark may be open.
